attempts.hypothesis: Cost is dominated by incoming request count and source heap removal work, with additional comparisons when incoming and destination priorities coincide.

pcvs.name: incoming_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures iteration, source heap copying, and one destination insertion per incoming request.

pcvs.name: incoming_count_squared
pcvs.rationale: Approximates the increasing cost of source heap removals across the bounded incoming queue sizes.

pcvs.name: overlapping_priorities
pcvs.rationale: For this workload, captures incoming priorities shared with the destination, which require arrival-time comparisons.
